fields.event: Analyst call after the Form 8-K of October 27
fields.preparedBy: Investor Relations with the General Counsel

questions.question: When did you decide the incident was material?
questions.answer: The disclosure committee determined it was material on October 23 and the Company filed on October 27.

questions.question: Was customer data taken?
questions.answer: We have not yet determined that; we will amend the report when we know.

questions.question: What will this cost?
questions.answer: We expect a material effect this quarter and will update with results.

doNotSay: Do not give a number beyond what is in the filing.
Do not describe the actor or its methods.

points: We filed an Item 1.05 report on October 27 and it is on our website.
Two of five plants were affected; one has restored scheduling.
Finance and payroll systems were not affected.
We will update investors when we know more about data and cost.
doNotSay: Do not estimate the final cost beyond the filed statement.
Do not say the investigation is complete.
Do not say a ransom was or will be paid.
